provenance.text:
Where the numbers come from

Every number is from the API's own A01 examples (api/athlete_api/examples: plan_A01, plan_A01_20km, elevation_A01, share_A01), formatted with the rules in web/src/plan/format.ts at the default pace of 6:00 /km. 'Passes 628 m away on foot' is the API's pass_walk_m.

The map is a schematic, not the basemap: pins sit at the API's snapped points and the line just joins them. The real screens draw the API geometry on the Kerala PMTiles basemap.

The runner faces west (mirrored): the API's first km mark is west of the start.

budget.text:
Retro budget (at most 3 per screen)

Counted: wordmark, pixel numerals, map markers, hard shadow. The pixel icon set is the icon style everywhere and is not counted.

Peek / half / full / over budget: markers, numerals, hard shadow (selected card or primary button). So the wordmark leaves the top bar once a route is on screen; it lives in the menu and About.

Setup: wordmark, runner, hard shadow on Next. The distance value is Inter, not pixel.

Share page: wordmark, numerals, static runner. Its buttons are secondary (no hard shadow).
